MyFace Beauty and Stylist is a beauty salon at 9 37th Street in Seshego-B, Polokwane, offering a focused range of face, body and bridal treatments. Its service list includes facials and general skincare, chemical peels, dermaplaning and facial extractions, together with makeup services and dedicated bridal makeup for wedding parties. Body treatments extend to body sculpting, giving clients more than a standard facial-only menu.

The salon takes bookings online, which suits clients who want to secure a specific treatment slot rather than walk in and wait. Trading from Seshego-B, it serves beauty clients across the wider Seshego area who are looking for skincare, makeup and bridal preparation in one place. The combination of facial, body and bridal services under one roof makes it a practical choice for brides organising hair, face and skin treatments ahead of a wedding day.

This Nedbank branch trades from the Pioneer Building at 52 Landdros Mare Street in Polokwane Central, where it appears on Nedbank's own branch locator as a full office branch with its own on-site ATM. Customers can carry out everyday banking at the counter, from transactions, account queries and card services to loan applications, with the ATM available for cash withdrawals and deposits.

Having both a staffed office and an ATM at one address sets this branch apart from the standalone Nedbank ATMs dotted elsewhere around the CBD, such as those at nearby fuel stations and retailers. It serves personal and business banking customers working or living in and around Polokwane Central who need a full-service Nedbank branch within walking distance of the CBD, whether for a quick transaction or an in-person consultation.

Ntsoane Optometrist is an optometry practice trading from Shop 7B in Seshego Plaza on New Era Drive, Seshego. Its own profile among medical-aid providers summarises the practice simply as specs, consultation and lenses, covering eye examinations, spectacle frames and prescription lenses for patients who need their vision checked and corrected close to home.

Because it is listed with a managed-care optical network, patients covered under participating medical aid schemes can have consultations and optical benefits processed directly through the practice rather than claiming separately afterwards. The practice notes that bookings are required, so patients are seen by appointment rather than on a walk-in basis. It serves residents of Seshego and the surrounding area who need routine eye tests, new spectacles or a lens update without travelling into central Polokwane.

Ocean Basket Savannah Mall is the local branch of the national seafood and sushi restaurant chain, trading from Shop G4-5 in Savannah Mall in Fauna Park. The menu centres on seafood and sushi, including sharing platters designed for groups, alongside the chain's broader selection of grilled and fried seafood dishes.

Diners can eat in at the mall or arrange a takeaway, and the branch also offers delivery and takes reservations for parties who want a table booked in advance. This flexibility suits shoppers stopping for a meal between errands as well as families and larger groups planning a sit-down dinner. Trading from one of Fauna Park's busiest retail centres, the restaurant is a convenient seafood option for shoppers and residents across the northern side of Polokwane.

The store carries the PEP range of affordable clothing and footwear for men, women and children, along with the household basics and everyday items the chain is known for.

Being based in the City Centre building puts it within easy reach of other shops and offices in the CBD, making it a convenient stop for shoppers already in the area rather than a destination on its own. Regular in-store promotions, advertised through PEP's own sale catalogues, mean the range and pricing change through the year. The branch serves value-conscious shoppers and families across central Polokwane looking for affordable clothing and footwear without travelling to a mall.

Beyond courier bookings, the branch gives customers access to PostNet's digital services, including internet stations, credit reports, email services and fax-to-email, alongside the printing, copying and mailbox services the brand is known for. This mix of courier, digital and print services makes the Bendor branch a convenient stop for individuals sending a parcel and for businesses that need document printing, courier dispatch or office support in one visit.

Rev M.P. Malatjie Primary School is a public primary school at 711 Zone 8 in Seshego, Polokwane, operating within the Limpopo Department of Education's public schooling system. It is classified as a Quintile 3 school, placing it among institutions serving communities with moderate socio-economic status, and it is designated a no-fee school, so parents are not charged tuition fees.

As a Quintile 3 institution, the school is eligible to receive funding of up to R1,602 per learner from the Department of Education each year to cover operational costs and educational resources. Admission follows the national framework set out in the South African Schools Act, with registration for the following academic year generally open between April and October. The school serves primary-level learners from Seshego and the surrounding community within the Seshego urban suburb of Limpopo Province.

Alongside buying and selling, the branch offers short-term loans secured against valuables, with the option to extend a loan, as well as a six-month lay-by facility for customers who want to pay off an item over time. It serves customers in the Polokwane Central area who are buying or selling used goods or who need a short-term, asset-backed loan.

items.description:
Tshoseletso Day and Mobile Spa is an owner-managed spa in Welgelegen, Polokwane, offering treatments at its day spa and as a mobile service at clients' homes. The business was established in 2010 as a mobile spa and later expanded to include a full day spa. The day spa offers massages, facials, mani and pedi, body treatments, make-up and waxing.

The mobile service brings spa treatments to clients at home, at a hotel, in an office or any other location they choose, which saves a trip out and back. Corporate massages and retainer options are available, and the spa serves individuals, corporates and events. The business says its therapists are dedicated and passionate about giving each client treatment suited to their needs.

Tyremart Polokwane CBD is a tyre-fitment centre at 57 President Paul Kruger Street in Polokwane Central, offering tyres, batteries, brakes, shocks and suspension work. Its services also include wheel alignment, towbars, exhausts, mag repairs, wheel bearings and nitrogen fill. The branch stocks run-flat tyres and steering rack ends for customers who need specialist parts.

Customers can request quotes online, and the website lets drivers save their tyre sizes for quicker quotes on later visits. The company promotes leading tyre brands, and the branch is part of a national network with stores in Aliwal North, Cradock and East London. Drivers in the CBD can combine a tyre change with brake or battery work in one visit.

Yellow Lemon Tree is an interior store at 39 Staal Street in Ladanna, Polokwane, which is described as the city's first dedicated interior store. It sells imported wooden furniture, decor and exclusive fabric collections, including wooden mirrors, dining chairs, stools, consoles, coffee tables and hanging lights. Wall decor, seagrass scatter covers and pots and vases are also part of the range.

Beyond retail, the business offers interior decorating, re-upholstery, custom furniture, custom-made curtains and wholesale supply to resellers. Customers who want advice can contact the team at the warehouse by phone or email, and the online shop highlights its best-selling pieces.

Adega Portuguese Restaurant is a Portuguese seafood restaurant in Hampton Court, Bendor, at the corner of Pierre and Neethling Streets. The business began in the late 1990s as a place where people could meet and enjoy traditional Portuguese food, and it is known for seafood, chicken and steaks. The restaurant has a contemporary, upmarket setting with indoor and outdoor areas.

The restaurant has a heritage of more than 25 years, and the brand's website describes dining there as an experience beyond a traditional restaurant, with dishes such as prawns, seafood pasta and steaks. The venue also hosts indoor and outdoor functions. The Adega brand also runs lounge and pod formats, along with an Adega Go option.

Adendorff Machinery Mart Polokwane is a branch of the national machinery and tools retailer at 31 Nikkel Street in Superbia, Polokwane. The store stocks generators, power tools, welding equipment, air compressors, garage equipment and woodworking machinery. Its compressor range includes belt drive, direct drive, oil free and petrol-driven models, along with pneumatic tools and airless sprayers.

The company says it sources equipment from all over the world to offer a wide range at competitive prices. Customers can contact the branch by phone or email to check stock or ask about a product before visiting. The Polokwane branch is listed on the chain's store locator, which makes it easy to find from anywhere in the city.

Its services include commercial contracting, credit agreements, criminal law, debt recovery, general litigation in the High Court and lower courts, mediation and nuptial services. The firm also handles corporate, family, labour, divorce, commercial and immigration law, along with conveyancing.

The firm says it strives to provide practical solutions to clients and their legal needs, and prospective clients can book a legal consultation through the contact page. Its office is in a business building in Bendor, which makes it convenient for clients across Polokwane who need legal advice or representation.

This public primary school on Ngwato Street in Lebowakgomo serves around 1,456 learners with a teaching staff of 40. It is classified as a Section 21 self-reliant school, which means its governing body manages part of its own budget, and as a no-fee school, so families do not pay school fees. The school carries a national EMIS number and forms part of the Capricorn South schools cluster in the Capricorn District.

The school's postal and street address is in Lebowakgomo, and its profile places it in an urban location within the Lepelle-Nkumpi local municipality. Its profile is classified as Quintile 3, which is useful for parents comparing primary schools in the area.
